name: Sound Pass
description: Evens out the interview voice in the active sequence: every phrase of every speaker brought to the same loudness, the top held at -6 dB on the meters by a Hard Limiter on each voice clip (Lee's V1 settings). The lift goes in as the limiter's Input Boost (sounds the same as clip gain, which scripts cannot set) plus Volume keyframes for phrase-to-phrase changes. Works on a safe copy; measured from Premiere's own render.

inputs.label: Voice tracks (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. A5, A6; empty = every clip playing a .wav (wireless) on an unmuted track

inputs.label: Even out every phrase (Volume keyframes); off = one level per clip
Keep my music/camera balance (they move with the voice)

actions.label: Even out interview audio
actions.confirm: Even out the interview voice on a safe copy of this sequence? Every voice clip gets one Hard Limiter (ceiling -6 dB on the meters) with its own input boost, and with Even out every phrase on, Volume keyframes so quiet and loud phrases and different speakers sound equally loud. Volume keyframes from an earlier Sound Pass run are replaced. Only the TOOLKIT COPY changes; clip gain and faders are left as they are, and nothing is saved.
